focus.$description: Width of the focus outline (the forced-colors rule; the canvas node focus).

frosted.$description: Geometry of a frosted surface (D-47); its colours are color.surface-frosted and color.surface-frosted-shadow. No mode.

blur.$description: Radius of the backdrop blur: how far what scrolls beneath the surface is smeared.
Blur radius of the small shadow. The shadow has no offset: it reads the same under a bar at the top and above a bar at the bottom.

base.$description: shadcn's --radius: the radius every step is derived from.

step.$description: The derived steps of FOUNDATIONS.md § Base values: the base radius × the factor in $extensions['pa.scale']. Mapped to Tailwind's --radius-sm … --radius-4xl in src/index.css.
